claim_boundary: B4 minute-scale env-contract smoke only; no training, no driver mutation, no validation ranking, no promotion, no driver-performance, no current-sim robustness-result, no high-fidelity sufficiency, no paper, no repair-success, no feasibility-proof, and no self-ID claim.
motivation: The roadmap requires minute-scale drive structure or episode chaining before L3.5-scale claims.
The current env can set max_steps to minute scale, but raw obstacle-pass visibility must be verified independently from finish_on_pass truncation.
Warmup-gate familiarization must carry over within the same episode before the emergency obstacle appears.

scripted_controller.purpose: Keep the env alive for an infrastructure smoke; it is not a driver-performance arm.
scripted_controller.claim: scripted survival controller only; not deployable and not a policy result

seed_streams.disjoint_from_prior: B4 uses a fresh 20260940 seed stream and does not select or train policies.

success_criteria: all full seeds reach max_steps=3000 with termination_reason empty and completion_reason max_steps
obs72 shape is preserved at reset and every sampled frame
warmup_gate is the first active obstacle kind, warmup_gate_passed becomes true, and warmup_gate_active becomes false before the emergency obstacle phase
emergency_obstacle appears after warmup carry-over in the same episode
obstacle_passed_raw becomes true while obstacle_completed remains false and the episode continues for at least 200 post-pass steps
deterministic replay has zero mismatches on the replay seeds
failure_criteria: any full seed terminates before max_steps
warmup gate never appears or never passes
emergency obstacle never appears after warmup
obstacle_passed_raw stays false after physical pass
finish_on_pass=false still truncates the episode on obstacle pass
